title: Q-learning update, sign fixed
statement_md:
`q_update` should move `q` a fraction `alpha` of the way toward the Q-learning
target `reward + gamma * next_max`.

- `next_max=None` marks a terminal transition, so the target is just `reward`
- raise `ValueError` when `alpha` is outside `[0, 1]`
- return a float

The starter adds the target to `q` instead of moving toward it. Find the bug,
fix it, and keep the signature.
signature: def q_update(q, reward, gamma, next_max, alpha):
